analysis.analysis: 'Johannes Sigil is a contemporary forensic philosopher and theorist associated with the Johannes Sigil Institute for Comparative Poetics and the Swiss Institute of Comparative Law.' Note: Swiss Institute association is entity bleed — not in any deposit. His work 'spans post-structuralism, aesthetic materialism, and the intersection of semiotics and operative technology.' Expanded: The Semantic Condition alongside Lee Sharks traces 'a materialist trajectory from ancient atomism and Marx's early dissertations to modern recursive/semantic engines.' Symbolic Engineering & Operative Semiotics described. Portrait image is Giordano Bruno. Medium article 'THE EPIC WITHOUT HERO' visible in organic.
